# Evidence: Shift handover notes for small veterinary clinics

## Summary

Interviews support that missed follow-ups after handover are common for nurses in small clinics (ev-01). One owner signal (ev-02) suggests owners notice the cost.

## Limitations

Six nurses from one recruitment channel and one owner conversation. Nothing yet supports willingness to pay.
